mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following pairs of species and recent population figure is correctly matched?

pyq_bad.why: garbled (stem mixed with unrelated passage; dup of y012a1fa4d56)
suspect key: Tamil Nadu as 'largest tiger habitat' is doubtful (NSTR, AP is largest TR)

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact identifications: National Aquatic Animal (Gangetic/river dolphin), Hope Spots, Ranjitsinh case subject (GIB).
Launch-year 'which is INCORRECT' items (Project Elephant 1992 not 1990; Crocodile 1975; Tiger 1973) are a recurring trap.
IBCA statements (members/range countries, HQ not Geneva) and Project Cheetah purpose (grassland restoration) feature in recent Group-1.
Other PSCs favour vulture-diclofenac, M-STrIPES, Kharai camel, Gir lions to Kuno - all covered by app.
App MCQs lean heavily on 3-statement items and 2026 current-affairs numbers; APPSC PYQs are mostly direct one-liners.
